PraisonAIUI is more than a single chat window. In the default React app shell (style: app), you can pair conversational AI with live data pages, selectable layouts, a header Notification Center, custom themes and installable plugins — all from one server.

Add KPI cards, filterable tables, charts, forms and Markdown runbooks next to your chat. Declare full pages in app.yaml — and split big apps across files with $ref:. Edits reload dynamically without restarting the server. Run it with aiui run app.yaml.

Switch one app between Chat + Canvas, Workbench, Command, Guided and Mission Control. URL query filters, POST forms, lazy tabs, auto-refresh, live sidebar badges and YAML $ref pages. Push real-time alerts over SSE to the header bell with read/unread state and deep links. Pick from 20+ color presets, light/dark modes, or ship full React pages as Python plugins.

When you want an out-of-the-box operations console for your agents, enable built-in pages with aiui.set_pages("all") (or pick specific IDs with aiui.set_pages(["chat", "sessions", "agents", "logs"])). Every page shares the same theme, navigation and authentication. See Dashboard and Focused app.
